authoritativeAbi.runtimeJustification: Active runtime is Node v20.18.0 as an x86-64 ELF executed under Blink (x86-64 emulator to wasm32). x86-64 Linux syscall numbering is authoritative. Consistent with AW3 evidence and the D1 decoder's own declared scope.

phase2_syscallDecoderRepair.rootCause: Duplicate object-literal key 0xe8 assigned to both clock_nanosleep (wrong) and epoll_wait (correct). clock_nanosleep is 0xe6; the decoder had written it as 0xe8, colliding with epoll_wait's authoritative 0xe8.
phase2_syscallDecoderRepair.additionalCorrectionsRationale: Audit of the full decoder against syscall_64.tbl surfaced three further wrong numbers (eventfd, eventfd2, ioctl) beyond the compiler-reported duplicate. Leaving known-wrong mappings would ship a decoder that mis-decodes real syscalls, violating 'do not weaken decoding'. All numbers verified against the authoritative table.
phase2_syscallDecoderRepair.structuralHardening: Table restructured from a raw object literal to a ReadonlyArray of [number, name] tuples built into a Map via buildSyscallMap(), which THROWS on any duplicate numeric key. Duplicate keys are now a hard init/test failure instead of a silent TS overwrite.

phase3_messageUnionRepair.rootCause: TS2345 at index.ts:224 unreachable(event.data). The d1_trace_export variant existed in the WorkerMessage union (defined in worker.ts:19-31) and was produced by worker.ts exportD1Trace(), but the main-thread dispatcher switch had no case for it, so event.data narrowed to the d1_trace_export type (not never) at unreachable().
phase3_messageUnionRepair.workerTsModifiedNote: The union member d1_trace_export ALREADY existed in worker.ts (source 08bceae5). No modification to worker.ts was required or made. The correction is entirely consumer-side in index.ts.
correctionApplied: Added exported interface D1TraceExport with explicit stats schema {total,captured,dropped}.
Added exported decodeD1TraceExport() validator: fail-closed (returns null) for malformed payloads, never throws.
Added Machine event map member d1_trace: D1TraceExport.
Added switch case 'd1_trace_export': decodes payload and emits 'd1_trace' when valid; drops silently when malformed.
Left unreachable(event.data) intact in default so unknown message TYPES still fail closed and the exhaustive switch compiles without casts.

phase4_scopedChecksAndCanonicalBuild.canonicalCommandProvenance: Makefile TSC rule: 'dist/index.js dist/index.d.ts &: $(shell find src -type f)' runs $(TSC); reads tsconfig.json (include src/**/*.ts). Same command proven by AW3 and used in the failed P0 run.
phase4_scopedChecksAndCanonicalBuild.criticalProvenanceNote: The successfully-built worker.js SHA (00045d33) equals the previously QUARANTINED failed-build worker.js SHA. This is expected and correct: worker.ts source (08bceae5) was already valid; the earlier build failed ONLY on sibling type errors (d1-syscall-decoder.ts, index.ts) and TS still emitted worker.js from valid worker.ts. Now the whole build succeeds, so 00045d33 is the product of an EXIT-0 canonical build. Identical bytes, fundamentally different provenance (failed vs green). The quarantined copy remains excluded from every deploy/serve path.
